status: 静态设计概念，示例数据
basePrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic production-quality desktop web application UI effect image for Personal Workflow OS, displayed brand "Workflow OS". The attached user image is the authoritative STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target: preserve its warm ivory/off-white base, subtly warmer left sidebar, ink-black text, forest green accents, Chinese Song/Ming serif display headings with clear sans-serif control labels, calm editorial typography, fine pale dividers, understated near-square corners and extraordinary whitespace. No gradients, decorative illustrations, glass, big shadows, rainbow dashboard metrics, devices, browser chrome, or poster surround. Target dimensions 1487 x 1058 pixels, matching reference aspect ratio. One full screen per image, never montage. Maintain reference shell: 203px left sidebar, 65px top header, brand upper left; navigation 今日 / 项目 / 任务 / 知识 / 动态 / 待审 with small elegant outline icons and green active indicator, 连接 / 设置 at bottom. Top right date "2026-09-19 星期六"; current date anchor 2026-09-19 Asia/Shanghai. Chinese labels must be clear and carefully typeset. Footer tiny "设计概念 · 示例数据". Product is a single-user human-AI long-term project workflow system. It has immutable artifact versions, distinct task status/execution mode/current executor, evidence-driven reviews; never imply AI returning text equals completion or that passing tests automatically completes a task. Focus a hero use case, one clear primary action, only 1-2 supporting areas. Use grouping, alignment and whitespace first, dividers second, tint third, borders sparingly and shadows last. Avoid cards inside cards, cramped text or clipped controls. Match the attached image's 14-16px UI body scale, large editorial heading and reference density. No more than two type families. Use only features in page brief.
All text simplified Chinese. This is one sibling page of an established app, not a new design direction. Use precise reference visual language. Display a single polished full screen. Keep right detail rail only when needed. No marketing illustrations. Ensure comfortable sizes and visual hierarchy. Existing left nav must remain identical. Render every interactive control fully inside frame. Footer concept label required.
